Class ParquetDecimalAttribute

Namespace
ParquetNeo.DataModel
Assembly
ParquetNeo.Serialization.dll

The precision and scale of a decimal property's column. Without it a decimal is written with a precision of 38 and a scale of 18. A value with more decimals than the scale, or more digits than the precision, cannot be written. The column is INT32 up to a precision of 9, INT64 up to 18, and a fixed-length byte array above that.

[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Property, AllowMultiple = false, Inherited = true)]
public sealed class ParquetDecimalAttribute : Attribute
